map.→ 打开外币兑换（手动汇率）工具: -> Open the manual currency exchange tool
map.为什么和手机银行显示不一致？: Why does it differ from what the banking app shows?
map.出境旅游/海淘前，手动填入银行或外汇平台实时汇率，把本币金额换算成目标币，离线估: Before travelling abroad or shopping online, manually enter the live rate from your bank or FX platform and convert your home-currency amount into the target currency, so you can estimate offline how much you will get instead of being misled by vague counter quotes.
map.对比两个兑换渠道（银行牌价 vs 机场/商户）时，分别填入汇率与手续费，算出到手: When comparing two exchange channels (bank posted rate vs airport/merchant), enter the rate and the fee for each, compute the amount you receive, and pick the cheaper one.
map.手动输入银行或外汇平台提供的实时汇率后，在任意两种货币间双向换算金额并生成速查表: After manually entering the live rate from your bank or FX platform, convert amounts between any two currencies in both directions and generate a quick reference table, which suits offline estimates while travelling or shopping abroad; the result follows the rate you entered.
map.持有多币种时，按「1 原始=？目标」双向换算，生成速查表，途中快速心算小额消费。: When holding several currencies, convert both ways with "1 original = ? target" and generate a quick reference table so you can do quick mental arithmetic on small purchases while travelling.
map.本工具纯前端、结果完全取决于你填入的汇率与手续费，不含任何隐藏点差；与银行 Ap: This tool is pure front-end and the result depends entirely on the rate and fee you enter, with no hidden spread; the difference from the banking app comes from when the posted rate applies and from the buy/sell direction, not from a calculation error.
map.汇率填哪个价？: Which price should I enter as the rate?
map.用你实际兑换渠道的「卖出价」（你用本币买外币的价格）；若查到的是中间价，到手会略: Use the "sell" price of the channel you actually use (the price you pay in home currency for foreign currency); if you only found the mid rate you will receive slightly less. Cash and remittance rates also differ, and the cash buying rate is lower.
: enter the rate 1 CNY=0.138 USD and a 0% fee: received=10000x0.138x(1-0)=1380 USD. With a 1.5% fee: received=10000x0.138x0.985=1359.3 USD, so the 20.7 USD difference is the fee cost. In reverse, USD->CNY uses the rate 1/0.138≈7.246, so 100 USD≈724.6 CNY. Note: the rate follows the live posted rate you entered; bank buy and sell rates differ, and the amount actually received uses the "cash buying rate".
